<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex046022026-09-1605-51-18" status="unreviewed">'di <expan>dag gi</expan> khyad par la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs gter</rs> ba 'ga zhig</rs> ¦ 
<quote source="db:5564" n=""> <l>zhen yul rtog <expan>pa'i</expan> <lb n="10b1"/> khyad chos yin ||</l>   <l>zhen byed rtog pa kho na yin ||</l></quote> zhes pa'i rjes su 'brang nas ¦
rtog pa kho na la zhen yul yod kyi ¦ khyod rtog med kyi shes pa <expan>yin na</expan> ¦ khyod kyi zhen yul yod pa bud <note type="editorial">"bud" abbreviation for ?</note> zhes <note type="gloss">'bud<note type="editorial">"'bud" abbreviation for ?</note></note> pa dang ¦
<quote n="PV III.224 ¦ rgyu'i ngo bo ma gtogs pa'i || gzung ba zhes bya ci yang med"><lg><l>rgyu'i <expan>dngos po</expan> ma rtogs pa ||</l> <l>gzung ba zhes bya gzhan ci yang med ||</l></lg></quote> 
zhes <expan>pa'i</expan> don du bsaMs nas <lb n="10b2"/> blo de'i <expan>gzung yul</expan> <expan>yin na</expan> ¦ blo de'i <expan>gzung don</expan> yin pas khyab ¦ <choice><reg>des na</reg><orig>des ‹na›</orig></choice> khyod rtog pa <expan>yin na</expan> khyod kyi gzung yul yod pa bud ¦ 
zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">smra ba dag</rs> kyang <expan>snang ngo</expan><note type="editorial">Uncertain abbreviation</note> ¦

 'di skad du smra ba ni ¦
         <lg><l>** las kyang ber bu ste ||</l>
         <l>'dze med las kyang '0dzem med pa ||</l>
         <l>byis las gyis sa phyugs las phyugs ||</l>
         <l>blun po yis ni spyod la ltos ||</l></lg>
         zhes bya ba ni gnas skabs <expan>thos so</expan></seg></TEI>
